at_sod.b64: base64 of a real-world EF.SOD (Austrian sample) taken verbatim from
the test data of github.com/gmrtd/gmrtd v1.2.0 (document/sample_document.go,
"EF.SOD (real-world AT sample)"). It contains only certificates and hashes, no
personal data. gmrtd is MIT licensed; its notice is in LICENSE-gmrtd.txt and
applies to this file. It is used to prove that SOD signature verification
interoperates with a real chip-signed SOD; its DSC is long expired, which is
intentionally not checked locally (validity is the PDP's decision).
